answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before it can attest transactions, with the bond slashed when peers prove its work false. Reputation then grows only slowly from verified history: a fresh identity starts at zero and cannot buy or copy another record, so trust is earned step by step, like a pearl forming layer by layer. An attacker wanting ten influential identities must fund ten bonds, wait through ten slow histories, and risk losing every deposit if caught. A basalt-hard penalty and a sable audit trail linking bad attestations to the bond make fakes cost more than they gain.
